summary: Platform for creators to sell digital products and memberships directly to customers.
access_note: Create an application in account settings and click Generate access token for your own account; OAuth for other users.

evidence.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.
Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API and should be kept secret, like a password.
if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token
Every assistant connects to its own URL and asks for OAuth access to your Gumroad account.

notes: Help article and gumroad.com/mcp read via curl. API reference page gumroad.com/api is JS-rendered (only "API" visible), so breadth (products, sales, subscribers, offer codes) is from pass-1 search results, not a vendor quote.
